svg.title: Amara Nest technical drawing 2
svg.text: AMARA NEST / POST LOCATION & HEART SHELL
A = rear plane of the attachment boss.
B = left edge of shell in the front view.
C = lowest point of the shell.
Wall thickness at this point only.
Post position is measured from shell outline references B and C.
S–S passes through the post centreline.
0.81 is the local back-wall thickness at the indicated height.
